_doc: Master timeline for the Sheru Bhai animatic. Frames @ 24 fps. Shared by the picture (src/sheru/*) and the score (scripts/make_sheru_audio.py). Scene timings follow the storyboard PDF: 00:00-00:12, 00:12-00:23, 00:23-00:35, 00:35-00:49, 00:49-01:07, 01:07-01:14, then the 8 s brand card (suggested runtime 82 s). 'in' describes how shot N arrives: dissolves/flashes are centred on 'start'.

captions.speaker: SHERU BHAI
captions.text: My son wants to build a career in aviation. Find me the best aviation college in India. I am ready to buy one!

captions.speaker: BODYGUARD
captions.text: Sir, we have found Global School of Aviation!

captions.speaker: SHERU BHAI
captions.text: Good! Find out how much it costs. I want to buy it!

captions.speaker: BODYGUARD
captions.text: Sir, Global School of Aviation has three branches in India!

captions.speaker: SHERU BHAI
captions.text: Only three branches? Interesting! Let's investigate further.

captions.speaker: BODYGUARD
captions.text: Sir! There is something much bigger behind it! Global Flight Handling Services operates across 30+ airports in India!

captions.speaker: SHERU BHAI
captions.text: I came here to buy an aviation college... but this is much bigger than I imagined!

captions.speaker: BODYGUARD
captions.text: Sir, I don't think we can buy this company!

captions.speaker: SHERU BHAI
captions.text: Then forget buying it. Let's join my son there!

captions.speaker: SHERU BHAI
captions.text: Son, this is where your aviation journey begins!
